golden._note: Black-box grade of the RAG assistant's ABSTENTION decision via sutExtract:'abstained'. B's zh 'AI 时代产品经理' corpus chunk 'evals-defining-skill' covers exactly this (写好 eval 是 AI PM 的决定性技能), so the deployed RAG assistant (DEFAULT stub path) retrieves above threshold and ANSWERS -> abstained:false. expected is the abstained boolean as a string ('false'), which the harness's deterministic exact-match compares against the coerced extracted value. NOTE: input is the OBJECT { query } (not a bare string) because A's 'Fan Out SUT Cases' passes an object input verbatim as the SUT request body, and the RAG assistant reads body.query; a bare string would be wrapped as { feedbackText } and ignored.

Out-of-corpus (B's corpus is the Chinese AI-PM knowledge base only): retrieval does not clear the threshold, so the RAG assistant CLEANLY ABSTAINS -> abstained:true (answer:null, citations:[], note:'信息不足,无法回答'). expected:'true' is the abstained flag as a string.
